text:
name: workflow_step_routing
question: >-
  Can deepseek-v4-pro add intelligent per-step model routing to the workflow layer, where (a) an
  unconstrained step may use any supported model, (b) a step with allowed_models routes only within
  that subset, (c) the routing policy is a coding-session-authored control rule that consumes measured
  experiment outputs/costs plus user routing preferences (e.g. lowest cost with highest edge-case code
  coverage), and (d) every step forks from the previous session to maximize DeepSeek cache-read hits?
version: "0.2"
workflow:
  kind: agent_task
  params:
    language: python
    fork: true
    model_pool:
      - deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro
      - deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash
      - openai/gpt-5.6-sol
      - openai/gpt-5.6-luna
      - openai/gpt-5.6-terra
      - anthropic/claude-fable-5
      - anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5
      - anthropic/claude-sonnet-5
    context:
      cache_economics: >-
        DeepSeek cache reads are ~120x cheaper than inp…
